svg.aria-label: What wsl-spawner reads: WSL's own answers, a running distribution's systemd, journal, units and containers, and on Windows the sign-out scripts, the wait and the event logs. It runs as you and changes nothing before you confirm: each distribution you set it up in, the sign-in program and its settings, and as an administrator the sign-out hook and the wait.
